verdict: SOX in macro-driven correction (-12% over 6 sessions on CPI/rate fears); AI capex guidance intact at ~$720-745B but Q3 hyperscaler earnings imminent; DRAM price momentum slowing but positive; optical sector whipsawed; no company-specific structural breaks.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (Last 24-72h)

**Chip sector macro selloff (ongoing):** SOX shed ~12% over six consecutive sessions through Oct 15, driven by hotter-than-expected September CPI reviving Fed-rate fears — not an AI-fundamental break. NVDA -1.43% Oct 16 ($214.13); AVGO -4.52% Oct 16 ($328.75) with a CEO "gamblers" comment adding sentiment noise. Broad risk-off, not design-win loss.

**DRAM/HBM pricing (TrendForce, Sept 30 print):** Q4-2026 conventional DRAM contract prices projected +10-15% QoQ; PC DRAM +13-18% QoQ; NAND +15-20% QoQ. Momentum is decelerating meaningfully from Q1's +90-95% QoQ surge — still positive, but the memflation spike is cooling.

**Optical whipsaw:** COHR +10%, LITE +9% on Oct 1 (Coherent's PhotonLink CPO platform launch + Bernstein Outperform initiations on COHR/LITE/CIEN). Then Oct 12 reversal: COHR -7.87%, CIEN -10%, LITE -10% with no confirmed catalyst (profit-taking after extended run). Lumentum 200G lasers remain sold out at ~2x prior ASP.

**CRDO fresh analyst action (Oct 13):** 24/7 Wall St. buy, $258.39 price target; cited CRDO fiscal Q4-2026 revenue +157% YoY, forward P/E 31x vs MRVL 62x and ALAB 56x. Structural AI connectivity tailwind intact.

**Solar policy:** Section 232 minimum import prices take effect Dec 4, 2026 (polysilicon $21/kg, cells $0.22/W, modules $0.38/W + 15% global tariff). No fresh FSLR/ENPH/NXT/ARRY-specific catalysts Oct 17.

**HIVE (BUZZ HPC):** No fresh Oct news. Last update: Aug 17 $350M/5-yr GPU cloud deal with NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra cluster; targeting $200M HPC ARR by year-end. Monitor for Q4 ARR confirmation.

---

## Context vs Baseline

Hyperscaler 2026 AI capex guidance now ~$720-745B combined (vs baseline $600-700B) — above plan. Q3 earnings due late October are the next inflection: first potential guide-DOWN or guide-UP. HBM4 ramp slipping at SK Hynix (M15X live, Yongin Phase 1 to Q1-2027); Samsung and Micron expanding HBM capacity but Samsung still struggles with NVIDIA qualification. Correction-risk signal (post-2026 HBM oversupply) has not fired, but capacity expansion is on track. SOX macro correction does not negate the structural thesis.

---

| Custom ASIC share-shift | Gradual; NVIDIA still ~85% | Neutral |

| Solar/tariffs | Dec 4 policy tightening | Mixed (FSLR domestic bull, importers bear) |
| Macro/rates | CPI hot; SOX -12% in 6 sessions | Bear near-term |

---

## Most Important Development

**Q3 hyperscaler earnings (due late October) are the next binary catalyst.** The $720-745B capex guidance holds for now, but any first guide-DOWN from MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/META would be the most bearish structural event since the baseline was set. The current SOX selloff is macro-driven (rates), not AI-fundamental. Watch this window closely.
